based_on.not_used: A03 (a decorative mark judged weak), A04 (no reference survived the URL check), A01/A05/A06/A08 (no supporting input or reference)

policy_note: Same image policy as v2 (owner, 2026-10-21): AI concept images of the wagashi are allowed; a store, people, logos, copied designs and realism claims are not.
theme: A quiet, contemporary wagashi page with one clear focal pair: a framed image of the sweets and the shop name standing vertically beside it. Restraint instead of decoration; kinari paper, sumi ink and one azuki-toned hairline.

palette.name: kinari 生成り
palette.use: page background, most of the page

palette.name: sumi 墨黒
palette.use: the shop name, headings, body and fact text

palette.name: azuki 小豆
palette.use: one thin rule under the active nav and one hairline above the ledger; never a fill, never a button

sections.layout: Asymmetric, not a left-right split. Left: the AI concept image of a dorayaki cut in half, in a framed window with wide kinari ground around it. Right: the shop name 架空菓庵 set VERTICALLY (縦書き, top to bottom) in a large refined Mincho as one tall column. A steep size drop to the small horizontal header and to one quiet text link (no filled button).

Led by words, not by cards. The heading, then one sentence copied verbatim from the description set large in Mincho, horizontally; beside it one small framed AI concept image of a seasonal jō-namagashi. Never a row of equal product cards.
A narrow, precise ledger on the pale kinari band: a definition list (label, value) with hairline rules, all horizontal.

visuals.lighting: Soft directional daylight from one side, gentle shadows, warm but natural colour.
visuals.surfaces: Abstract materials only: washi paper, a pale wooden tray, a matte ceramic plate, linen. No room, counter or shop setting.
visuals.hero: The dorayaki cut cleanly in half: golden-brown castella layers and glossy tsubu-an with whole azuki beans.
visuals.inset: One seasonal jō-namagashi on a matte plate, small and quiet.
